## 1 Governance

Sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities are overseen through the entity’s governance and management structures and are connected to the entity’s overall approach to enterprise risk management and strategic decision-making.

### 1.1 Oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities

This subsection describes how the governance body oversees sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.

**Responsible governance bodies/individuals (current)**

Oversight is assigned to the **Board of Directors** and is supported by the **[Board committee responsible for sustainability/climate oversight]**. Day-to-day coordination and escalation to the Board/committee is supported by **[designated individual charged with governance for sustainability/climate matters]**.

Responsibilities for sustainability-related and climate-related oversight are reflected in the **terms of reference/mandates** of the Board and the relevant committee(s), and in **role descriptions and related governance policies** applicable to those bodies and individuals.

**How the governance body determines whether appropriate skills and competencies are available**

The Board/committee assesses whether appropriate sustainability and climate competencies are available by:

- reviewing a **Board skills/competency assessment** that includes climate-related expertise; and
- implementing a **skills development programme** and, where relevant, using **external advisors** to supplement expertise.

As at the reporting date, **[board_climate_expertise_pct]%** of Board members are assessed as having climate-related expertise.

**How and how often the governance body is informed**

The Board/committee is informed about sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities through:

- **scheduled reporting** provided **semi-annually**; and
- **agenda coverage** at Board/committee meetings, supported by management papers and dashboards.

**How sustainability and climate matters are taken into account in oversight of strategy, major transactions and risk management**

The Board/committee considers sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities when overseeing:

- the entity’s strategy and strategic priorities;
- decisions on major transactions (where relevant); and
- the entity’s risk management processes and related policies, including integration with enterprise risk management.

Where relevant, the Board/committee considers trade-offs associated with sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities as part of its review and challenge.

**Targets oversight and linkage to remuneration**

The Board/committee oversees the setting of sustainability-related and climate-related targets and monitors progress against those targets through periodic performance updates.

Sustainability/climate performance metrics are included in remuneration for **executives**, with a weighting of **[executive_climate_remuneration_pct]%**.

*Connectivity:* Governance oversight described above is connected to the disclosures in **Strategy**, **Risk Management**, and **Metrics and Targets**.

### 1.2 Management’s role

This subsection describes management’s role in the governance processes, controls and procedures used to monitor, manage and oversee sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities.

**Delegation and oversight**

Management responsibilities are delegated to the **[management committee name]** and the **[management-level position accountable for sustainability/climate]**. Oversight is exercised through management reporting and escalation to the Board/committee, including the **semi-annual** reporting cycle and escalation of material matters as they arise.

**Controls, procedures and integration with internal functions**

Management uses controls and procedures to support oversight of sustainability-related and climate-related risks and opportunities. These controls and procedures are integrated with other internal functions through **enterprise risk management (ERM)** processes (**ERM integration: [erm_integration_flag]**), including coordination with relevant risk, finance, and operational functions.

*Connectivity:* Management processes described above support the disclosures in **Risk Management** and **Metrics and Targets**.

tables_and_figures_added.markdown:
| Role | Primary responsibilities (sustainability & climate) | Key outputs / forums |
|---|---|---|
| Board of Directors | Overall oversight; reviews key sustainability/climate matters and progress | Board agenda items; semi-annual reporting |
| [Board committee responsible for sustainability/climate oversight] | Detailed oversight; reviews risks/opportunities, targets and progress; recommends actions to the Board | Committee papers; dashboards; minutes |
| [designated individual charged with governance for sustainability/climate matters] | Coordinates governance-level sustainability/climate matters; supports escalation | Briefings; escalations |
| [management committee name] | Management oversight; consolidates performance and risk information; escalates material matters | Management reporting; escalation packs |
| [management-level position accountable for sustainability/climate] | Day-to-day leadership; prepares reporting and coordinates internal functions | Dashboards; risk inputs; target tracking |
| Risk/ERM function | Integrates sustainability/climate into ERM processes | Risk registers; ERM reporting |
| Finance function | Supports governance reporting and controls where relevant | Management information; disclosures |
| Operational functions | Implement actions and provide data | Operational KPIs; action plans |
